Changelog ​

All notable changes to the Dutch B1 Curriculum are documented here.

2026-07-13 -- A0-05 Lesson Created and Integrated ​

  • Lesson ID: A0-05
  • Competency: Counting and Basic Quantities
  • Sections: All 20 sections from LESSON_STANDARD.md completed
  • Vocabulary Words: 60 new vocabulary items (cardinal numbers 0--100, ordinals 1st--10th, quantity adverbs, monetary vocabulary, measurement units)
  • Major Grammar Concepts:
    • Cardinal Numbers 0--100 (basic counting, individual numbers 0--20, tens forms 30--90, compound numbers 21--99 with reversed order)
    • "Hoeveel?" Question Formation (how many/how much, V2 word order with question words)
    • Ordinal Numbers 1st--10th (eerste through tiende with -de/-ste patterns)
    • Plural Noun Forms in Counting Contexts (--en and --s pluralization, plural article "de")
    • Number--Noun Agreement (numbers don't change, nouns do; één vs. een distinction)
    • Basic Monetary Expressions (euro, cent, prices with comma decimal notation, payment methods including "pin")
  • Dialogues: 5 realistic, practical dialogues (counting objects, asking prices, quantities, ordinals, age/dates)
  • Exercises: 10 specific exercise types (counting aloud, listening recognition, match numbers to words, hoeveel dialogue completion, ordinal ordering, money math, quantity word selection, age/personal numbers, reading/listening with numbers, write numbers as words)
  • Assessment Criteria: 4 measurable standards (counting standard, listening/comprehension standard, speaking standard, usage-in-context standard)
  • Research Location: shared/prompts/A0-05-research-request.md and shared/prompts/A0-05-research-response.md
  • Author: External research + OpenCode integration
  • Reason: Complete A0-05 lesson, continuing strict A0 lesson sequence (A0-01 → A0-02 → A0-03 → A0-04 → A0-05)
  • File Location: A0/Competency-5-Counting-and-Quantities/A0-05.md
  • Status: Complete ✅
